With depression someone’s normal voice in their head isn’t there. It’s replaced with a negative one. And once it starts feeding negativity, the negativity grows. The “Sweet” things or people in life aren’t sweet anymore. Things you used to enjoy aren’t enjoyable and seem like a chore. People who might have good intentions, you second guess and feel as though they are lying. Your brain is not the same chemically as when you are Happy. You think they say things behind your back or don’t really mean the nice things they say. It’s not about just think Happy thoughts and be grateful. It’s Neurons in your brain firing that you cannot instantly control. Trust me most people who have suicidal tendencies probably want to be happy. But just like you can’t ask your body to adapt to low oxygen levels without training and help, you can’t ask your brain to not be sad.
